events.headline: Wholesome: Grand Blue Dreaming keeps its diving-club chaos going
events.summary: A comedy series following college students and their diving club's misadventures.

events.headline: This Month: The Elusive Samurai returns for a second season of outsmarting the enemy
events.summary: The visually distinctive samurai series continues following an eight-year-old noble who relies on evasion tactics rather than combat strength to reclaim his position.

events.headline: This Month: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War reaches its final act
events.summary: The long-running shonen's last season, subtitled -The Calamity-, depicts the climactic battle between Ichigo Kurosaki and antagonist Yhwach, closing out one of the genre's biggest sagas.

events.headline: Sci-Fi: Tomb Raider King sends its hero fifteen years into the past
events.summary: A webtoon adaptation whose protagonist discovers a relic that lets him travel back fifteen years — to before supernatural tombs began appearing worldwide.

events.headline: Psychological: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day pairs orphaned soldiers with an immortal roommate
events.summary: A dark fantasy yuri about orphaned girls trained as soldiers, centered on a peace-loving student and the immortal roommate she's paired with.

events.headline: Isekai & Fantasy: Saga of Tanya the Evil follows a reincarnated girl up a wartime chain of command
events.summary: A dark fantasy military series about a girl reincarnated into a magic-infused world war, climbing the ranks of an imperial army.

events.headline: Summer 2026 is one of the most stacked anime seasons in years
events.summary: The season is overflowing: long-running heavyweights like Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War continue, Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha returns to TV after decades away, and a wave of new adaptations lands alongside them. If you'd sooner watch by…

events.headline: Psychological: The Summer Hikaru Died is the quiet horror to watch
events.summary: A slow-burn psychological thriller with a horror undercurrent, The Summer Hikaru Died turns a small-town friendship into a study of identity, vulnerability, and superstition — unsettling without leaning on jump scares.

events.headline: On the radar: five summer shows with breakout potential
events.summary: Beyond the sure things, a handful of summer titles are being tipped as possible hits of the year — worth a slot in your queue if you like getting in early on something before it blows up.

events.headline: Isekai & fantasy: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 is the season's most-hyped return

events.headline: Cyberpunk & sci-fi: Science SARU reimagines Ghost in the Shell
events.summary: Science SARU's The Ghost in the Shell follows Major Motoko Kusanagi and Section 9 through complex cybercrimes in a neon future, blending Masamune Shirow's original style with the studio's animation — and the mystery, action, and psychologi…

events.headline: Cozy & wholesome: 100 Girlfriends has a surprisingly warm heart
